puzzle.body: If Go 1.13 gains NullTime in the stdlib, use that instead.
puzzle.author: Duncan Holm

puzzle.body: Make generated constants extra type-safe by delcaring a new type (e.g. `type foo string`) then using that type for each of the constants (e.g. `const ( fooBar foo = "..." ...)`). For this to work, I think at least an implementation of https://godoc.org/database/sql/driver#Valuer would have to be generated too.
puzzle.author: Duncan Holm
